Title: Block Sort Puzzle
Description: Block Sort Puzzle is an exciting multi-colored block sorting puzzle that will test your logic and attentiveness! Sort as fast as possible to collect the highest tower, as well as to multiply your points! Nice animation of moving tiles.
Instructions:
How to play:
- Drag the blocks onto the desired tile.
- Put the same colors side by side to combine and score points.
- When combining blocks, the multiplier of the current points increases.
